items.actClause: AN ACT to amend chapter 699 of the laws of 1947, relating to authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the town of Southold, Suffolk County, in relation to authorizing the acquisition, construction, equipment and operation of a public ferry for hire from Fishers Island across waters of Long Island Sound; authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the town of Southold, Suffolk County and providing for the election of its officers and management of its affairs; authorizing the collection of ferriage charges; authorizing the issuance and sale of obligations of said town and providing for their payment; authorizing the levy and collection of taxes; and providing for other related matters; and to repeal certain provisions of chapter 699 of the laws of 1947, relating to authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the town of Southold, Suffolk County, relating thereto
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6278

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend chapter 699 of the laws of 1947, relating to
authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the town
of Southold, Suffolk County, in relation to authorizing the
acquisition, construction, equipment and operation of a public ferry
for hire from Fishers Island across waters of Long Island Sound;
authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the town
of Southold, Suffolk County and providing for the election of its
officers and management of its affairs; authorizing the collection of
ferriage charges; authorizing the issuance and sale of obligations of
said town and providing for their payment; authorizing the levy and
collection of taxes; and providing for other related matters; and to
repeal certain provisions of chapter 699 of the laws of 1947, relating
to authorizing the creation of Fishers Island ferry district in the
town of Southold, Suffolk County, relating thereto

 PURPOSE :

To provide for amendments to the Fishers Island Ferry Enabling Act.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Provides the district with the authority to accept personal
or real property necessary for the overall operation of the district.

Section 2. Gives the commissioners of the district the authority to
constrict and maintain the ferry and all other functions necessary for
its operation.

Section 3. Increases the district's bonding authority from $5M to
$20M.

Section 4. Provides for the qualifications of commissioners.

Section 5. Makes a technical amendment.

Section 6. Provides the district's airport facilities may include
hangers.

Section 7. Provides that all monies from ferriage charges shall be
deposited to the credit of the commissioners.

Section 8. Compensation for the personal attendance of commissioners
at each meeting will be increased from $50 to $100 with annual maximum
raised from $2,500 to $5,000. Provides for the quorum necessary to
conduct a meeting and for attendance of a commissioner by other than
personal attendance for which there will be no compensation; also
provides for filling vacancies on the board of commissioners.

Section 9. Provides for the duties of the manager and the power of the
commissioners to appoint and direct co-managers. Managers shall have
the duty to report to the commissioners monthly for the payment of
obligations of the district.

Section 10. Provides for the election of commissioners and sets the
qualifications for eligible voters in district elections.

Section 11. Removes the town board from the obligation of approving
the annual estimates

Section 12. Repeals section 14 of the act, which was added in 1968 to
ratify and validate a particular claim.

Section 13. Renumbers existing section 15 of the act to section 14 and
substitutes the commissioners for the town board for purposes of
establishing and maintaining reserve funds.

Section 14. Renumbers existing section 16 of the act to section 15.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Fishers Island is a small island approximately 7 miles long and 3/4
mile wide situated in Long Island Sound five miles off the coast of
New London Connecticut. The island is a part of the town of Southold
in Suffolk County and is approximately 25 miles from Long Island. The
population of the island is approximately 236 year round residents
growing to 2000 in the summer months. The primary form of
transportation to and from the island is the Fishers Island Ferry,
which run to New London on a varying seasonal schedule. The Fishers
Island Ferry District was created by Chapter 6999 of the laws of 1947.
It runs the ferry and operates a general aviation airport (Elizabeth
Field) on the island. Ferry service is funded by a tax levied on all
privately owned properties within the district and through ticketed
sales and freight fees. The fleet consists of two vessels which were
built in 1978 and 1985 and will be needing replacement in the near
future. This bill would increase the bonding authority of the district
from $5M to $20M to accommodate the costs of replacement.

Also, the district has been in operation for over seventy years and is
desirous of conducting its operation without oversight from the town
of Southold. The town similarly agrees that the district should
operate as an independent entity. This bill would provide for that
along with clarifying the duties of the commissioners. In addition,
the bill sets out revised qualifications to serve as a commissioner as
well as qualifications for voting in district elections.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

Section 2. Effective date.

ates a general aviation airport (Elizabeth Field) on the island. Ferry

New bill.
